subject: [AMBER] Installation Issue: cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim copy to cSim failed no kernel image is available for execution on the device

messages.author: Johannes Loeffler
messages.body:
Hey,
I just upgraded my GPU and wanted to install amber24.
Has anyone managed to install amber24 on an rtx5090? if yes, which versions of cuda did work for you? I currently get the error message when running the make.cuda.serial:
cudaMemcpyToSymbol: SetSim copy to cSim failed no kernel image is available for execution on the device
Thank you for your support!
Best,
Joe
